import subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources/rainbow2209.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'sources/rainbow2209.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(r.stdout[:25000])
